title: Investigating Memorization of Conspiracy Theories in Text Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the memorization and elicitation of conspiracy theories within generative language models like GPT-2. It treats conspiracy theories as a form of harmful information or misinformation rather than investigating religious systems, spiritual traditions, or formal ethical/moral reasoning frameworks. The included 'Ethical Considerations' section is a standard discussion of potential risks and not a primary evaluative component.
